run_main_visualize_co3d: run the main function to visualize CO3D dataset object point clouds and render flyaround videos
create_pointcloudrenderingmodel: create a PointcloudRenderingModel to render point clouds from a CO3D dataset sequence with configurable render size
render_point_cloud_forward: render point cloud images, masks, and depths from a camera using the PointcloudRenderingModel forward method
visualize_3d_scene_plotly: visualize a 3D Plotly scene with cameras and RGBD point clouds from CO3D dataset frames
get_rgbd_point_cloud: get an RGBD point cloud from camera, image, depth map, and foreground probability data
